title: Switch to Rental Adds Five Storeys, Larger Units to 1255 Bay Proposal
summary: A new Minor Variance application to the City of Toronto seeks a height increase for 1255 Bay Street in Yorkville, raising the approved 39-storey proposal to a 44-storey tower. Designed by Zeidler Architecture for KingSett Capital, the revised scheme would replace 399 condos suites with 329 larger rental units.
